spans.s: गाध् vt. or vi. 1Ā (pp. गाधित) 1. To stand, to stay; 2. to set out, अगाधत ततो व्योम हनूमानुग्रविग्रहः Bt.viii.1; 3. to seek, to search for, to inquire for; 4. to compile, to string or weave together.
गाध (I) a. (f. धा) Fordable, not very deep, shallow, सरितः कुर्वती गाधाः पथश्चाश्यानकर्दमान् R.iv.24.
गाध (II) n. 1. A shallow place, a ford; 2. a place, a site; 3. desire of gain, cupidity.
